name: optcatalog_play_impact_sound
description: OptCatalog::PlayImpactSound selects a random impact sound for an impact slot and plays it at the hit position.
known_limits: The smoke target uses the accepted zSndSample::PlayA3D dependency with an inert backend selection to observe the selected sample path without requiring a real audio backend.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog impact-response source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0fd0 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogHitEventPartial*, impact slot as the first stack argument, gain scale as the second stack argument, impactFxTable slot stride 0x4c, soundCount at +0x1c, random sound index from (rand() * soundCount) >> 15, soundSamples base at +0x20, hit position at hitEvent +0x0c, null velocity, and dispatch to zSndSample::PlayA3D.
The native OptCatalog smoke verifies a zero sound count skips playback and a populated slot dispatches to the selected zSndSample::PlayA3D path.
